text: Hard hats on, fools out. What do you want?
Dagny Bell, foreman. Goldwater's the richest rock in the Reach and the most dangerous. Both at once.
If you're here to dig, see the assayer. If you're here to die, see the Deep Seam.
The one who came back up from the Seam! Drinks are on the company. Don't tell the company.
Night shift's the worst. You hear things down there. Knocking.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.

options.label: Any work for a brave fool?

text: The deepest shaft on Goldwater. We hit a vein so rich you could see it by lamplight. Then we hit something else.
Lost two crews. Sealed the bottom. Something's been knocking on the seal ever since.
Quill Hart the assayer buys raw gold at a fair rate. Fairer than Kingsport. Don't tell Kingsport.
The cliffs are full of it. Bring a pick, bring a lamp, bring a friend who runs slower than you.
Twenty years in the mines of the mainland before I came out here. Never saw the sun. Now I see it every day and I still don't trust it.
